# test_runner_path.sh through bin/velo-openrouter-agent). CI installs exactly this set (python-tools.sh), so it runs the packages the
# suites were written against and a new upstream release cannot turn a green run red. It is `uv pip freeze` of
# ~/.venvs/velo-openai-agents (CPython 3.13), the venv bin/velo-openrouter-agent tells you to build with 'openai-agents==0.22.2'.
